commands_and_contracts.context_gate: refuses silently when rt_interrupt_get_nest()!=0, or PRIMASK is set (sp_intr_masked()), or rt_thread_self()==NULL; never waits for a Sensor frame before refusing
commands_and_contracts.argument_parsing: own strict unsigned decimal parser with overflow pre-check; sign, trailing characters, exponent, missing or extra arguments are rejected; no atoi/atof; permission is never inferred from a response containing the substring 'armed'
commands_and_contracts.sampling: polls sensor_service_get_latest(); counts only new seq; fresh_current==0 or valid_current==0 is not a new measurement; records dup/invalid/skip/seq-reset; deadline = N*20ms + 500ms capped at 12000 ms; online u64 statistics, no N-element array on the tshell stack
commands_and_contracts.side_effect_contract: show and sample change no coefficient, source, motion or protection state and never write Flash; apply and nominal touch only the three cal fields in RAM; config_save remains a separate explicit action and was not invoked
commands_and_contracts.confirmation_semantics: CONFIRM_MEASURED is a human evidence-responsibility marker only; it does not mean the MCU verified the meter and is not approval to go ACTIVE
commands_and_contracts.single_entry_rule: no second synonymous dangerous entry point was kept

current_adc.c: cal_input_ok(): finite offset in 0..3300 mV, finite gain in 0.001..100 V/A, source in {NONE, THEORETICAL, MEASURED}
cal_apply() publishes offset/gain/source/calibrated/version inside one rt_enter_critical/rt_exit_critical window
legacy current_adc_read_measurement() now delegates with cal==NULL; its contract and the NONE semantics of the public API are unchanged
project_config: cfg_apply_from() returns rt_err_t and validates before publishing
config_in_range() aligned with the ADC domain and accepts only THEORETICAL/MEASURED as source
every runtime publication moved inside cfg_lock (set :189, set_calibration :223, load :263/:274/:284, config_default :360, boot :398); Flash I/O stays outside the lock
calibration_api_changes.sensor_service.c: frame mA and current_cal_source now come from one cal snapshot; sensor_frame layout, log schema and valid/fresh semantics unchanged
motor: holds mot_lock across the recheck and the coefficient commit
no general callback exported, owner/phase never forced, recovery never bypassed
calibration_api_changes.disclosed_tightening: gain 0.001..100 V/A is a new numeric-safety range to stop mA output/integer overflow; it is NOT claimed as a hardware-validated range and the board nominal stays 0.6 V/A
